name: branch-management
description: Branch lifecycle skills backed by dedicated subagents: new-branch cuts a fresh work branch via the branch-agent (haiku), new-pr reviews the branch with code-review plus the codex, copilot and coderabbit CLIs (parallel haiku reviewer agents running bundled scripts), applies verified fixes via the opus review-fixer, pushes, opens a PR or MR via gh or glab, and watches CI and CodeRabbit feedback until green via the sonnet ci-monitor.
